text:
Alex P.: Heads-up — I’m seeing ~$12k spike in preemptible GPU charges in eu-west1 over the last 24h, lots of untagged spend. Anyone else noticing this?
Lina T.: Yep, noticed weird uptick. Dashboards show a bunch of short-lived VMs from a new autoscaler group. No cost_center label. :eyes:
Sanjay R.: Investigating. Quick BigQuery slice I ran on the billing export:
```sql
SELECT project.id AS project, labels.cost_center, service.description AS sku, SUM(cost) AS cost
FROM `company-billing.gcp.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
WHERE _PARTITIONTIME BETWEEN TIMESTAMP('2026-03-01') AND TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 0 DAY)
  AND labels.cost_center IS NULL
  AND LOWER(service.description) LIKE '%gpu%'
GROUP BY project, labels.cost_center, sku
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Results show ~92% of the spike from project `redwood-training-prod` and instance name prefix `worker-prod-preempt-`.
Maria (FinOps): If it's preemptible batch runs we can retro-allocate, but need an owner mapping. Do we have `owner` or `team` label elsewhere?
Alex P.: Looks like the autoscaler template in terraform was missing labels; it used default service account so nothing downstream got tagged. I grep'd the repo and found the ASG config: `google_compute_instance_template` missing `labels`.
Lina T.: I can open a quick PR to add `labels = { cost_center = var.cost_center, owner = var.owner }` to the template. Will do by EOD.
Sanjay R.: For immediate triage we can find instances missing cost_center and patch them. Quick gcloud to list missing label:
```bash
gcloud compute instances list --filter='zone:(eu-west1-*) AND NOT labels.cost_center:*' --format='table(name,zone,labels,serviceAccounts)'
```
And to add a label (one-off):
```bash
gcloud compute instances add-labels worker-prod-preempt-42 --labels=cost_center=platform --zone=eu-west1-b
```
I’ll run a dry-run to identify top candidates and then a safe patch tomorrow morning at 03:00 UTC.
infra-bot: Created INF-4721: "Untagged preemptible GPU spend spike — redwood-training-prod" and attached the billing export slice.
Maria (FinOps): For chargeback, rule of thumb: use labels > service account > instance name regex for attribution. If ambiguous, allocate to Platform pool and tag as 'investigation'. I can prepare a draft retro chargeback sheet.
Alex P.: Can we automate both prevention and retro attribution? Ideas: org policy to require `cost_center` on compute instance templates, and Cloud Function that backfills labels based on instance name regex + serviceAccount mapping.
Sanjay R.: Agree. Also propose a periodic BigQuery job that writes a mapping table: `unlabeled_instances` -> probable_owner with confidence. We'll use that for automated split if owner missing.
Maria (FinOps): For this incident, preliminary split proposal: Product-Search 75% (~$9k), Platform 25% (~$3k). I'll confirm after we run the labeling job.
Alex P.: Action items: Lina — PR to terraform adding labels + CI check for missing labels (EOD). Sanjay — run discovery + backfill job (tomorrow 03:00 UTC) and produce list (INF-4721). Maria — prepare retro chargeback doc and notify teams (Friday). I'll sync with Legal if any discounts/credits are available. :thumbsup:
Lina T.: filing PR now, adding terratest to assert `labels.cost_center` exists on templates.
Sanjay R.: Will also add a firewall to prevent preemptible pools from being created without a tag via org policy. Drafting policy now.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline for `redwood-training-prod` shows an autoscaler bump at 2026-03-16T21:14:12Z that aligns with the spike.
Alex P.: Good catch. That bump was from an adhoc retraining job — we should gate large retrainings behind a cost checklist.
Maria (FinOps): Once labeling/backfill runs, I'll update billing export and post final numbers in INF-4721. Planning to charge teams in April invoice cycle.
infra-bot: Reminder scheduled — follow-up check in 48h.
Alex P.: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread for updates. If you find instances that require special handling (data deletion, sensitive projects), @mention me. :fire:
